summary: [standards] Brief F6 says every `*_INCOMPLETE` code has a reason; seven of the fifteen registered ones (BATCH_INCOMPLETE aside) have none (ARTIFACTS_STORE_INCOMPLETE, CHANGE_ADOPTION_INCOMPLETE, HOOKS_INSTALL_INCOMPLETE, LEDGER_COMPACT_INCOMPLETE, PLUGIN_SYNC_INCOMPLETE, RETENTION_PURGE_INCOMPLETE, TIER_INCOMPLETE). If F6 means a meaning and fix per code they have them; if it means a reason row, the table is short. The owner should say which; code-reasons (canon-0-36-code-reasons) decides the reason names, so nothing is asked of this change. Also: the stop of EVIDENCE/FINDING/DIVERGENCE_INCOMPLETE carries no `data` (the staged location is in the message and meta.next[0] is `gate promote --dry-run`, which itself exits 2 with PROMOTION_INVALID while the record is refused); the brief asks for a read in meta.next[0], which is met.
